answer: The venue emails a one-time entry code to the registered address shortly before the doors open, and the vertex of the design is that the code is valid only for the named recipient and only during the entry window. The hollow of the scheme is that the code is checked against the registration list at the door. A Sybil cannot forward one email to a hundred accounts, because the code is bound to a single registration, and the spiral of the check rejects any code presented by the wrong person.
